locationsSkipped.note: Its site, https://lakecitysopranos.com/, returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on fetch and a wayback-machine fallback is unavailable in this environment, so the official page could not be read. A search turned up third-party listings placing Lake City at 11754 15th Ave NE 98125 and describing the lead address, 7729 24th Ave NW 98117, as a separate Soprano's location in Loyal Heights, but neither is confirmed against the pizzeria's own site, so no address is reported for this entry.

Its site, https://www.ananaspizzeria.com, is a JavaScript-rendered page: fetches of the homepage, /contact, /menu, /visit, and /location all returned either a bare page title with no body text or HTTP 404, so no address, neighborhood, or Instagram link could be read from the pizzeria's own site. The lead, 1106 8th Ave, Seattle, WA 98101, matches third-party coverage (Seattle Met, Curiocity) describing a First Hill location, but those are not the pizzeria's own site and so do not satisfy confirmation; the lead is not reported as a site.

Third-party delivery listings describe a 516 15th Ave E address under the name 'Olympia Pizza and Spaghetti House III', suggesting the lead belongs to a different, separate business, not this entry. Lead not added.
